simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to דִּנְהָבָה (H1838) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-pr-loc.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.
simple.summary: דִּנְהָבָה (Dinhâbâh) means Dinhabah , an Edomitish town First listed occurrence: 1Chr 1 43.

definitions.full: H1838. Dinhabah דִּנְהָ֑בָה proper name, of a location capital city of king Bela in Edom Gen 36:32 = 1Chr 1:43 ; identification with Tennib (perhaps = Thenib , near the edge of the Belka, east-northeast from Heshbon, described by Tristr Moab 222 ) by Neubauer Acad. 1891, 260 compare Tomkins ib. 284 . דָּנִיֵּאל see דָּנִאֵל below דין . דֵּעָה דֵּעַ, see below ידע . דְּעוּאֵל (רְעוּאֵל) see below רעה ידע, .
